diagnosis: The application is running but database-backed requests fail. A manually created Docker service can skip scripts/deploy/start.py by using the Dockerfile's former direct Uvicorn CMD.
fix: Use python scripts/deploy/start.py as the Docker image default and Render Docker command. The backend also loads Supabase Root 2021 CA into pg8000's SSLContext with certificate and hostname verification enabled.
latest_bootstrap_result: Render reached the Supabase Session Pooler; the remaining certificate-chain failure is addressed by the bundled Supabase CA. Production redeploy verification remains pending.
